node.title: Re^3: Why does default $_ only work
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I do not believe chomp is taking the LHS of the assignment and working with it that scalar.

No, that's incorrect, [doc://chomp] does modify its argument and the return value of the assignment my $selection = is the lvalue $selection, which [doc://chomp] operates on. The use of [doc://chomp] in this code is correct and has nothing to do with the problem, it's a = vs =~ problem.
